content:
Fernando and Jeff dive deep into the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 announcement, sharing hands-on impressions of Samsung's latest foldable form factor, the pros and cons of the new 4:3 aspect ratio, efforts to address the crease issue, and what it all means for Apple's upcoming foldable iPhone.

  • This episode is sponsored by Bitwarden: recommended password management tool featuring an Apple Watch authenticator integration, secure autofill on Safari and iOS apps, and business-grade security tools to make managing all your account credentials a breeze.

9to5Mac Overtime is a weekly podcast primarily in video format exploring interesting observations across the Apple ecosystem, hosted by 9to5Mac's Fernando Silva and Jeff Benjamin. Subscribe to Overtime on Apple Podcasts and our YouTube channel for more content.
